_note: The Underdeep, level 11: dark, and the air kills. See docs/zones.md.

exposure.name: foul air
exposure.warn: Your head swims. The air's going bad. Get to a lamp station.
exposure.hurt: You can't get your breath. The foul air is choking you.
exposure.relief: The pumps push clean air in. You breathe again.

ud_shaftfoot.name: The Shaft Foot
ud_shaftfoot.description: The bottom of the old shaft. The cage hangs above, creaking.

ud_lampstation.name: Ketta's Lamp Station
ud_lampstation.description: A lamp station with a hand-pump wheezing clean air in. The only light for a mile.

ud_workings.name: The Old Workings
ud_workings.description: Tunnels in every direction, timbered and sagging.

ud_gloom.name: The Gloom Gallery
ud_gloom.description: A long gallery with a dead lamp station halfway along.

features.lamp: A dead lamp, its reservoir dry.

ud_crawl.name: The Crawlway
ud_crawl.description: A tunnel you have to crawl through. Scratching ahead.

ud_pump.name: The Pump Room
ud_pump.description: A great pump, silent. If it ran, the whole level would breathe.

features.pump: Its lamp-boiler is cold. Oil would start it.

ud_tally.name: The Last Shift
ud_tally.description: Picks dropped where they were swung. A tally board on the wall.

features.board: The last shift's tally. Someone has scratched DON'T DIG DEEPER under it.

ud_shore.name: The Black Lake Shore
ud_shore.description: A lake of black, still water under a cavern roof. A brazier stands cold on the shore.

features.brazier: A signal brazier for the boats that used to cross.

ud_mirror.name: The Black Mirror
ud_mirror.description: A point where the lake is so still it shows a sky: a night sky, with a moon far too big. It isn't a reflection.

ud_worm.name: The Worm's Gallery
ud_worm.description: A tunnel bored perfectly round, as wide as a house. Something lives at the end of it.

lamp_oil.name: flask of lamp oil
lamp_oil.description: Ketta's lamp oil, thick and sweet-smelling.

tally_board.name: tally board
tally_board.description: The last shift's tally board, prised off the wall.

ketta.name: Ketta Lampwright
ketta.label: Lampwright
ketta.description: small, sooty, with a lamp on her hat
ketta.details: Small, sooty, with a lamp on her hat.

topics.work: Ask me about the mask, the lamps, the shift, or the worm.

mask.text: Down here the air goes bad as you walk. My lamp station pumps clean air. Anywhere else you breathe what's there. Here: a mask.

lamps.text: Three dead lamp stations: the Gloom Gallery's lamp, the Pump Room's pump, the brazier on the Black Lake shore. Light them with my oil and the deep breathes again.

shift.text: The last shift never came up. Their tally board's in the far gallery. I want to know what they found.

worm.text: The Stone Worm, at the end of its own tunnel past the lake. It ate the last shift. Nothing stops its crush. Leave it, if you've any sense.

topics.lake: The Black Lake shows a sky that isn't ours. A moon. Miners who looked too long walked in.

lampwrights_flask.name: Lampwright's Flask
lampwrights_flask.perfect_hit: {actor} drinks from the lampwright's flask, and it takes.
lampwrights_flask.description: Ketta's restorative: oil-smelling, and it works.

wormtooth.name: Wormtooth
wormtooth.description: One of the Stone Worm's teeth, set in a haft. Slow, and terrible.

miners_mask.name: Miner's Mask
miners_mask.description: A leather mask with a charcoal filter. Keeps off the foul air.

canvas_overalls.name: Canvas Overalls
canvas_overalls.description: A miner's overalls, patched with leather. +1 Resilience.

mask.goal: Ask Ketta Lampwright for it: ASK KETTA ABOUT MASK.

effects.text: Ketta hands you a mask. "WEAR MASK. Without it, five breaths and you're done."

oil.goal: Take Ketta's oil: ASK KETTA ABOUT OIL.

lamp.goal: Relight the lamp in the Gloom Gallery: USE OIL ON LAMP.

effects.text: The lamp gutters and catches. A little air moves.

pump.goal: Start the Pump Room's pump: USE OIL ON PUMP.

effects.text: The pump coughs, then thumps into life.

brazier.goal: Light the brazier on the Black Lake shore: USE OIL ON BRAZIER.

effects.text: The brazier flares, and the black water throws it back a thousand times.

back.goal: Tell Ketta: ASK KETTA ABOUT LAMPS.

get.goal: Find the last shift's tally board, deep in the galleries: GET BOARD.

back.goal: Bring it to Ketta: USE BOARD ON KETTA.

effects.text: Ketta reads the scratched words twice. "They dug into the worm's tunnel. Here. Keep your legs dry."

kill.goal: Kill the Stone Worm, at the end of its tunnel past the Black Lake. Its crush can't be blocked or dodged.

back.goal: Tell Ketta: ASK KETTA ABOUT WORM.
